description.narrative: (Sri Lanka): .SCORE promotes reconciliation and social cohesion addressing underlying grievances that led to Sri Lanka's civil war, mistrust between ethnic and religious groups, and segregation in the political, economic, and cultural arena..SCORE addresses structural drivers that enable violent extremism. It acts as a change agent to Sinhalese Buddhist and Muslim communities in the Southern, Central, and Eastern Provinces, promote open dialogue, and extend support to coexistence societies and inter-religious committees to strengthen social harmony and religious tolerance. SCORE will partner with Ministry of Justice, transitional justice mechanisms such as Office of National Unity and Reconciliation, Office of Missing Persons (OMP)and Parliamentary select committees to address issues of communal and religious harmony, and national unity. It will support social media campaigns to counter fake news, social engineering, and radicalization of youth along religious lines, and provide sub-grants to religious networks to carry out social cohesion and reconciliation activities. Through small grants and technical assistance it will promote youth networks to strengthen the moderate youth voices in society through non-violent communication and inter-communal activities..To meet Sec. 7044(e)(1) requirements, it will explore an OMP partnership to provide capacity building, advisory support, document management, and technical assistance to help process a backlog of documentation. As an alternative, SCORE may train civil society and provide technical assistance to bolster capacity to create public awareness of the OMP, advocate for identification, and support family members of missing persons. . SCORE advances ICS Objective 2. $1.22 million within this IM contributes to the DRG Directive...
